exposure: trial of labor with breech presentation following failed external cephalic version (ECV)
assisted vaginal breech delivery without prior ECV attempt
cohort: The study included 229 women with singleton term pregnancies attempting vaginal delivery, categorized into groups based on breech presentation with or without failed ECV, or vertex presentation after successful ECV.
finding: A failed external cephalic version does not adversely affect maternal or neonatal outcomes in patients undergoing a trial of labor with a breech presentation.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in successful vaginal delivery rates between breech delivery groups with or without a prior failed ECV, but the vertex-ECV group had a higher rate of vaginal delivery compared to the breech groups.
